dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Someone left notes here... Wait, Jebrael left these notes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jebrael, that name sounds so familiar. Hey, isn't that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like Jebrael and Samail were still friendly at that time. They were from the same tribe, after all... Maybe they came here together.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hm... Is this stone they left on the side of the road actually the keystone from the records...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's really not sure how this thing might work... Hey, {NICKNAME}, do you have any idea what it can do?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The symbol on the slate is lighting up!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Right after activating the symbol on the slate, the keystone turns into sand and disappears.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, the keystone suddenly turned into sand! Paimon didn't see that coming.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the keystone and the slate are related... Paimon never thought we'd find new clues about the slate here. We should go tell Tirzad when we have time!
